key_insight: ImputeECG can reconstruct missing parts of incomplete 12-lead ECGs while preserving observed signals, making archived or partially digitized ECGs more usable for AI analysis.
clinical_relevance: This could expand access to AI-ready ECG data from incomplete records and improve downstream diagnostic and risk-prediction performance in clinical datasets.
method: Mask-conditioned 1D Transformer autoencoder for ECG completion
Trained on PTB-XL and tested on PTB-XL, CPSC2018, and a real-world Kailuan cohort
Evaluated reconstruction error, waveform morphology, and downstream classification/sex-age prediction
evidence_signal: Across simulated incomplete settings, the model substantially reduced missing-region error on PTB-XL and CPSC2018, and completed ECGs improved downstream AUROC/AUPRC and real-world sex/age prediction after image digitization.
watch_item: Performance was assessed mainly under simulated missingness and one digitized clinical cohort, so broader robustness across devices, noise types, and extreme signal loss still needs confirmation.
paper_title: ImputeECG: Deep Learning Reconstruction of Complete 12-Lead Electrocardiograms from Incomplete Recordings for Cardiac Assessment
